title: Jonah's Anger and the Lord's Compassion

questions.question: How did Jonah react to God relenting from destroying Nineveh?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:1 (ESV): "But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry."

questions.question: Jonah prayed, "For I knew that you are a ___ God and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love."
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:2 (ESV): "for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love,"

questions.question: What did Jonah ask the Lord to take from him?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:3 (ESV): "Therefore now, O Lord, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live."

questions.question: What did the Lord appoint to grow up over Jonah for shade?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:6 (ESV): "Now the Lord God appointed a plant and made it come up over Jonah"

questions.question: What attacked the plant the next day so that it withered?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:7 (ESV): "But when dawn came up the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant, so that it withered."

questions.question: Where did Jonah go and sit to see what would become of the city?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:5 (ESV): "Jonah went out of the city and sat to the east of the city and made a booth for himself there."

questions.question: God asked Jonah, "Do you do well to be ___?"
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:4 (ESV): "And the Lord said, 'Do you do well to be angry?'"

questions.question: I knew that you are... abounding in steadfast love, and relenting from what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:2 (ESV): "abounding in steadfast love, and relenting from disaster."

questions.question: When the sun rose, God appointed a scorching ___ wind, and the sun beat down on the head of Jonah.
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:8 (ESV): "When the sun rose, God appointed a scorching east wind,"

questions.question: Jonah said about the plant, "Yes, I do well to be angry, angry enough to __."
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:9 (ESV): "And he said, 'Yes, I do well to be angry, angry enough to die.'"

questions.question: God said, "You pity the plant, for which you did not labor, nor did you make it grow, which came into being in a night and..."?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:10 (ESV): "which came into being in a night and perished in a night."

questions.question: Should not I pity Nineveh, that great city, in which there are more than how many persons who do not know their right hand from their left?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:11 (ESV): "in which there are more than 120,000 persons who do not know their right hand from their left,"

questions.question: In addition to the people, God also mentioned pitying what?
Jonah prayed to the Lord saying this was why he made haste to flee to where?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:2 (ESV): "That is why I made haste to flee to Tarshish;"

questions.question: What did Jonah make for himself east of the city?
questions.explanation: Jonah 4:5 (ESV): "and made a booth for himself there. He sat under it in the shade,"

key_verse_text: And he prayed to the Lord and said, "O Lord, is not this what I said when I was yet in my country? That is why I made haste to flee to Tarshish; for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, and relenting from disaster."
